services_shape: set services and packages with a chosen provider; each part has its own length, its own kind of provider and its own room, in a set order
questions_before_times: how many guests, and is everyone 18 or older
the service or package, and the massage length
for a couples booking or a party: each guest's service
safety_stop: a reaction happening now to an oil or a skin product: a swelling face, lips or throat, or trouble breathing
chest pain, fainting or a fall during or after a treatment
first_steps: Health form (each guest's own, on the secure page)
license: switches from each state's form: a massage license for each person who gives massage, and an esthetics license for each person who gives facials and body treatments, where the state's rules require them
staff_skills: massage (Swedish, deep tissue, hot stones, prenatal) and facials and body treatments; only people with the skill and the license for a part are offered for it
messages_never: health answers (pregnancy, injuries, allergies, skin treatments) never go in a text or through the AI: only each guest's secure page and the providers serving that guest; a staff text says only that a note exists
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
